english: It's been a while since I came back to the office.
Nyaun.
Woof woof!
With my Dream Hunter power finally back,\nI can keep the "Paranormal-Case Detective"\nshingle up, I suppose.
Still, I can't settle down\nat the Ayanokouji Detective Agency yet.
Quite right, Rem.
...To think you'd appear here.
clear-all command
How are you feeling?
Should I say "thanks to you"?
Fufufu... that spirited talk of yours\nonly works with your true power.
What's your business?\nYou didn't come to turn yourself in?
I've come to formally challenge you to a duel.
Oh? Since when do you like fighting fair and square?
Tomorrow at 14:00, I'll wait at Okugahara.\nI look forward to facing you.
Fufufu... fufufufufu!
//Doctor Shinigami vanishes.
One-sided as always...
But with everything arranged this far,\nI can't exactly refuse.
Still, why does Doctor Shinigami want\nto fight me at full power\nso badly?
He wasn't such a battle maniac...\nI don't get it...
//Battle map: plains\n//Doctor Shinigami and Rem initially deployed.
I've waited long for this moment.
I've got plenty to say.
First, I can't forgive\nall the incidents you've caused.\nI will defeat you!
But I have to thank you\nfor restoring my power... complicated, though.
No thanks needed.\nI didn't do this for you.\nIt's solely for fulfilling my grand wish.
Grand wish?
I wanted to try winning.\nAgainst Rem the Dream Hunter at full power.
Sorry, but\nI can't let that dream come true.
I'd be troubled if you held back.\nThat's why I deliberately told you my true intent now.
Then, let's go! Rem the Dream Hunter!\nHyaahaa!
Tch...
Come on, Rem. Get serious already!
As you wish — I'll beat you at full power!
//Rem transforms.
Return to the depths of hell!
Ooh... dream power overflowing enough\nto transform in the real world... good,\nit must be so!
//Battle start.\n//Event after 2 turns, or when Doctor Shinigami's HP drops below a set amount.
Not bad!
That's my line.\nYour power and skill haven't dulled.
//Mii appears.
There you are! Yeeay!
How rude... What do you want?
Obviously! I came to play!\nLet Mii join in!
//Mii sends out grunts too.
She's really going to wreck it!
What a brazen child...!
//Player units deploy.
Rem! Leave them to us!
Is ruining a duel fun?
It's fun! Because when I butt in,\neveryone gets really mad!\nEven kids who never get mad get mad!
This is what "I'd like to see your parents' faces" means.
Ahahahaha! No way~♪\nEveryone'll get beaten by Mii!
I won't let the old man get away either!\nKei-chan's furious\nabout Dark Rem being ruined!
Not my concern.\nRem, shall we continue?
Gladly!\nEveryone, babysitting duty please!
//Battle resumes.\n//Mii is too strong to defeat. Clear when Rem defeats Doctor Shinigami.
Nuooh... defeated by Rem again!\nWhy can't I win? What was my downfall!?
...It's over! Doctor Shinigami!
Aww, you lost already?\nHow old-man of you...
Then Mii's the star from here!
//Kei appears.
Mii, please return at once.
Kei...!
No! It's just getting fun!
Dark Rem's ego has fully awakened.\nShe has escaped.
Huh? She went somewhere?
Hmm, what should I do~?
I await your instructions.
Jeez, Kei-chan,\nyou're really bad at this stuff.\nCan't be helped~.
//Mii vanishes. All grunts vanish too.
Withdrawing.
//Kei vanishes too.\n//Battle end.\n//Background: plains
Fufu... should I be grateful\nto end quietly, undisturbed by rude intruders...
To hear the word "gratitude"\nfrom your mouth.
//Event CG: Doctor Shinigami's end
Rem, you wouldn't know.\nWhy I sought this kind of duel\nrather than enjoying slaughter's pleasure hidden in darkness.
Why is that?
To break the perfect plan\nand escape the wheel of fate.
The perfect plan...?
No one rules me!\nI achieved that... I have no regrets.\nRem, can you do the same?
What do you mean?
Fufufu... this is the end I wished for...!\nRem, stay strong.\n...Dream Hunter... Rem...
//Event CG off.
You got him?
Yes.
We won, but\nI can't quite celebrate honestly.
Even the way he lost was obnoxious!
I'm worried whether he really won't revive, desu~...
He's undying, right?\nWon't he come back again?
Should be fine for a while.\nAnd with this power of mine,\nI can protect us.
Then I'm relieved.
One tough enemy down —\ncan't you celebrate a little more?
Dejiko thinks so too, nyo!
Then let's have a victory party!
Doubling as Rem-san's recovery celebration.
At times like this, eat good food\nand restore your spirits!
Sounds good. I'm in!
Rem, you're really strong.
Fufu, I went from a normal girl\nback to a not-normal girl!
//fade to black\n//Background: abandoned building or some shady place
Made into a hiding place for dream power, huh...
But I can't just end up\nbeing used like this.
Rem, you too shall lose everything,\ntaste despair, and die...
Just like me...!
//END
